title: Rounding Off to the Nearest 10, 100 and 1 000
seo_title: Grade 4 Rounding Off Worksheets with Answers (CAPS Maths)
meta_desc: Free CAPS Grade 4 rounding off worksheets: round to the nearest 10, 100 and 1 000 with number lines and word problems. 100 questions with memos.
key_big: 5 or more: round up. Less than 5: round down.
key_sub: Look at the digit to the right of the rounding place.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • To round off, find the two multiples the number is between, then see which one is nearer.
  • Look at the digit just to the right of the place you round to. 5 or more: round up. Less than 5: round down.
  • 4 536 to the nearest 10 is 4 540; to the nearest 100 is 4 500; to the nearest 1 000 is 5 000.
  • We round off to estimate answers and check if an answer makes sense.

Examples

Example

Round 3 650 to the nearest 100

between 3 600 and 3 700

tens digit 5: round up

Answer: 3 700

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Rounding 5 down5 or more rounds up.
The wrong digitLook one place to the right.
Wrong zerosAfter rounding, the digits to the right become 0.

faq.a: Round off to the nearest 10, 100 and 1 000.
To estimate quickly and check answers.

faq.q: What is 9 950 rounded to the nearest 100?
Is rounding the same as rounding down?
faq.a: No. You round to the nearest multiple.

items.q: Which number rounds to 450 when you round to the nearest 10?
items.e: Numbers from 445 to 454 round to 450. 447 is in that range. 455 rounds to 460.

items.q: Which number rounds to 800 when you round to the nearest 100?

items.q: What is the smallest whole number that rounds to 600 when you round to the nearest 100?
items.e: Numbers from 550 to 649 round to 600. 549 has 4 tens, so it rounds down to 500. The smallest is 550.

items.q: What is the greatest whole number that rounds to 4 000 when you round to the nearest 1 000?
items.e: Numbers from 3 500 to 4 499 round to 4 000. 4 500 has 5 hundreds, so it rounds up to 5 000. The greatest is 4 499.

items.q: Round 6 348 to the nearest 10, the nearest 100 and the nearest 1 000. Which list is correct?
items.e: Always round the number you started with, 6 348. Nearest 10: the ones digit is 8, so 6 350. Nearest 100: the tens digit is 4, so 6 300. Nearest 1 000: the hundreds digit is 3, so 6 000. Do not round 6 350 again to get 6 400.

items.q: Estimate 2 987 + 1 045 by rounding each number to the nearest 1 000.
items.e: 2 987 rounds to 3 000 and 1 045 rounds to 1 000. 3 000 + 1 000 = 4 000. (The exact answer is 4 032, so the estimate is close.)

items.q: What number does the arrow point to?
items.e: From 0 to 10 000 there are 10 jumps, so each mark is 1 000. The arrow is 2 marks after 5 000: 6 000, 7 000.

items.q: What number does the arrow point to?
items.e: From 3 000 to 4 000 there are 10 jumps, so each mark is 100. The arrow is 1 mark after 3 500: 3 600. (3 060 counts each mark as 10.)

items.q: The town library has 6 752 books. How many is that to the nearest 1 000?
items.e: 6 752 is between 6 000 and 7 000. Look at the hundreds digit: 7. 5 or more, so round up. Answer: 7 000 books.

items.q: The school library has 4 815 books. How many is that to the nearest 100?
items.e: 4 815 is between 4 800 and 4 900. Look at the tens digit: 1. 4 or less, so round down. Answer: 4 800 books.

items.q: The car park at a shopping centre has 1 250 spaces. How many is that to the nearest 100?
items.e: 1 250 is exactly halfway between 1 200 and 1 300. A number that is exactly halfway rounds up. Answer: 1 300 spaces.

items.q: A stadium has 9 875 seats. 6 912 tickets were sold. Round each number to the nearest 1 000 to estimate how many seats were empty.
items.e: 9 875 rounds to 10 000 and 6 912 rounds to 7 000. 10 000 − 7 000 = 3 000. (The exact answer is 2 963, so the estimate is close.)

items.e: 8 512 is between 8 500 and 8 600. Look at the digit to the right of the hundreds place: 1, so round down. 8 500 km.
